projects.name: Teraco
projects.quote: During the third quarter, Digital Realty completed its previously announced acquisition of a majority interest in Teraco, a leading carrier-neutral data center and interconnection services provider in South Africa, for approximately $1.7 billion.

projects.name: Paris data center development parcel
projects.quote: Digital Realty acquired a 38-acre parcel, which can support approximately 80 megawatts of IT load, in Paris for $10 million.

projects.name: Stockholm data center development parcel
projects.quote: Digital Realty also acquired an income producing mixed- used building on a nine-acre parcel, which can support up to 10 megawatts of IT load in Stockholm $39 million.

projects.name: Crete, Greece data center development parcel
projects.quote: Lastly, Digital Realty acquired a one-acre parcel, which can support up to 6.5 megawatts of IT load in Crete, Greece for $2 million.

projects.name: Dallas campus adjacent parcel
projects.quote: Subsequent to the close of the third quarter, Digital Realty acquired a four-acre parcel, which could support 24 megawatts of IT load, immediately adjacent to its campus in Dallas for $24 million.
